ctgov.note: No company-sponsored interventional drug trials. Device studies are investigator-/site-sponsored (e.g. Sunnybrook NCT06175078, Mayo NCT07216274) using the FDA-cleared QT Breast Scanner.

devices.name: QTI Breast Acoustic CT Scanner (QT Breast Scanner)
devices.indication: Breast imaging (cyst vs solid characterization; supplemental imaging for dense breasts)
devices.regulatory_status: FDA cleared (510(k)); non-radiation, non-compression ultrasound tomography

devices.name: QTviewer
devices.indication: Cloud-based image viewing/analytics for breast imaging

excluded_partner_owned: Investigator-initiated observational studies of QT Breast Scanner at Sunnybrook (NCT06175078), Mayo Clinic (NCT07216274), and CMSC Japan — not company-sponsored interventional drug or pivotal device trials.
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical-imaging device company. Lead product (QT Breast Scanner) and software (QTviewer) are already FDA-cleared and commercially marketed. No proprietary drug pipeline and no active company-sponsored pivotal IDE clinical trials of new devices.
